# Landmark Landscapes

> Landmark Landscape Services, LLC provides residential landscaping in Prosper and nearby North Dallas communities in Texas.

Based in Prosper, TX 75078. Call 469-492-8450 or email landmarklandscapesllc@outlook.com. Use the contact page for estimates; pricing and schedules require confirmation. The homepage supports Accept: text/markdown. Other service pages are HTML unless an explicit Markdown link is listed.

## When to use this

- [Agent instructions](https://golandmarktx.com/agent-instructions.md): Use Landmark for homeowner landscape design, planting, drainage, stonework, irrigation repair and lighting in Prosper, Celina, Frisco, McKinney and The Colony. Read how to guide a homeowner to an estimate and when to obtain permission.
